notes: Only the wall sections between your commander and the camera fade now, instead of the whole wall.
The healing cross is a bobbing 3D cross that fades at the top of each bounce, and the medic kneels beside the guard while healing.
The gate and raid icons now hold perfectly still between waves; the pulse only plays while a raid is on.
The VIP goal is now outlined block letters that fill as you serve VIPs.
Level names only mention conveyors when the level really has a belt.
